turns.text: My flatmate ordered a print as a gift. Can you tell me the shipping address on SC-2372? I have the order number from the label, but I don't have the email they used.

I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order, including the shipping address, until I have both the order number and the email used on the order. I also can't guess the email. Your flatmate can give you the email, or you can ask them to contact us directly. Once I have both, I can help.
